description: Implementation of the SurfaceMtl class for Metal rendering backend in ANGLE, including frame capture utilities, surface initialization, drawable management, and rendering target handling.

classes.name: SurfaceMtl
classes.description: Represents a Metal surface for rendering, managing drawable textures, framebuffers, and synchronization with the display layer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Metal surface, setting up the CAMetalLayer and related resources.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates a default framebuffer object for the surface.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the surface current for rendering, obtaining the next drawable.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers, presenting the current drawable.

methods.name: obtainNextDrawable
methods.description: Retrieves the next drawable from the Metal layer, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: ensureDepthStencilSizeCorrect
methods.description: Ensures depth and stencil textures match the drawable size.

methods.name: checkIfLayerResized
methods.description: Checks and updates the layer's drawable size if the layer has resized.
